paper_title: On the Parameterized Intractability of Determinant Maximization
classifications: Theory of computation → Parameterized complexity and exact algorithms
statement: We investigated the W[1]-hardness of Determinant Maximization in the three restricted cases, improving upon the result due to Koutis [26]. Our parameterized hardness results leave a few natural open problems: For what kinds of sparse matrices is Determinant Maximization FPT? Is there a (1 − ε)-factor (rather than “additive”) FPT-approximation algorithm with respect to the matrix rank? Quantitative lower bounds can be also proved; e.g., due to the lower bound of k-Sum [41], Determinant Maximization on tridiagonal matrices cannot be solved in no(k) time, unless Exponential Time Hypothesis [23, 24] fails.
